question: (i) Name the electromagnetic waves used for long-distance radio communication. (ii) How are these waves produced? (iii) State one common use of these waves.

options.A:
(i) Microwaves are used for long-distance radio communication.
(ii) They are produced by hot bodies.
(iii) They are used in thermal imaging.
options.B:
(i) Radio waves are used for long-distance radio communication.
(ii) They are produced by accelerated charges in conducting wires.
(iii) A common use is radio or television communication.
options.C:
(i) Infrared rays are used for long-distance radio communication.
(ii) They are produced by special lamps.
(iii) They are used in remote controls.
options.D:
(i) X-rays are used for long-distance radio communication.
(ii) They are produced by nuclear reactions.
(iii) They are used in cancer treatment.
